sections.heading: C — Turning, Lanes, Passing
sections.markdown:
## C — Turning, Lanes, Passing

FACT_ID: sec13-F01 | anchor: A01
Reverse dulls control, so back slowly with a feathered or untouched pedal [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F02 | anchor: A01
Crane your head past the headrest, since mirrors and cameras alone crop the view and warp depth [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F03 | anchor: A01
Twist hips around, drape the right arm over the seat, grip the wheel top left-handed, and sight over the right shoulder [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F04 | anchor: A01
Sweep behind and through blind zones before and during, then creep off the brake with gas only as needed [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F05 | anchor: A01
Aim the wheel where you want the tail to go while watching travel through the rear side glass [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F06 | anchor: A01
Pre-pick your turn exit, bleed speed early, and scan for walkers and cars, shunning last-second sharp turns [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F07 | anchor: A01
Hold your arc: corner cutting and wide swings both invite crashes [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F08 | anchor: A01
Signal every lane change, turn, merge, and park to buy others reaction time, signaling even empty roads since blind zones may hide an audience [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F09 | anchor: A01
Iowa demands signals 100 feet before turns where limits run 45 mph or less, and 300 feet where limits run faster [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F10 | anchor: A01
Blink before braking, yet past intervening streets, drives, and waiting entrants first, then kill the signal after turning [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F11 | anchor: A01
Red lights allow right turns after a full stop and full yield unless a no-turn-on-red sign forbids [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F12 | anchor: A01
Red lights allow left turns only from a one-way left lane onto another one-way street [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F13 | anchor: A01
U-turn only where unprohibited and safe [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F14 | anchor: A01
Three-point turns court collisions, so favor the next intersection instead [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec13-F15 | anchor: A02
Lane moves span lane swaps, ramp merges, and curb entries; shift one lane at a time into confirmed gaps while yielding to occupants [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec13-F16 | anchor: A02
Announce with signals and hold pace unless dropping to a slower lane, scanning throughout for surprises [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec13-F17 | anchor: A02
Clear rearview and side mirrors of target-lane cars and imminent passers [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec13-F18 | anchor: A02
Shoulder-check the move side for rear-corner lurkers while pinning the wheel straight against arm-follow reflex [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec13-F19 | anchor: A02
Also scan the far lane for rivals diving at your same gap [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec13-F20 | anchor: A03
Pass only where signs and markings bless it, room truly allows, and need demands [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec13-F21 | anchor: A03
Take one car per pass and shun zones where cross traffic may pop from intersections and drives [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec13-F22 | anchor: A03
Open a pass by confirming open lane ahead, clearing mirrors and blind zones, then signaling and accelerating in [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec13-F23 | anchor: A03
Mid-pass watch fore, aft, and mirror, then re-enter gently once the passed nose shows in your mirror, cancel, and settle to safe speed [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec13-F24 | anchor: A03
Broken white lines in your lane bless same-direction passes, while solid-and-broken yellow pairs bless only the dashed side [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec13-F25 | anchor: A03
Double yellow centers ban both directions, with yellow dividing foes and white dividing friends [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec13-F26 | anchor: A04
Never pass cresting hills or rounding blind curves [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec13-F27 | anchor: A04
Never pass within 100 feet of signed narrow bridges, viaducts, tunnels, railroad crossings, or intersections [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec13-F28 | anchor: A04
Never pass on the right nor into oncoming gaps too tight to survive [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0046]

Misconceptions: mirrors and cameras suffice for backing, yet head turns rule; early signaling helps, yet it misleads waiting drivers; any red allows a right, yet signs can ban it.

Mnemonic: signal every shift, a hundred slow roads, three hundred fast; pass one, pass legal, pass back gentle.

Glossary: three-point turn (a tight reversal using forward and reverse legs); U-turn (a reversal turning back along the same road); blind spot (an area mirrors cannot show); no turn on red (a sign banning red-light turns).

Dynamic facts: none in these pages; every turning, lane, and passing rule above is stable handbook knowledge with no date-variable or place-variable values.
